scripts.build: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp svelte-kit sync && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp vite build
scripts.preview: bun run build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp wrangler dev worker/index.ts --local
scripts.test:unit: bun test src/lib/client src/lib/domain/mail src/lib/server/auth src/lib/server/config src/lib/server/db/deliveries.test.ts src/lib/server/db/messages.test.ts src/lib/server/email.test.ts src/lib/server/inbound/parser.test.ts src/lib/server/outbound/gateway.test.ts src/lib/server/outbound/system.test.ts
scripts.test:remaining: bun test scripts src/lib/server/http/api.test.ts src/lib/server/resend-webhook.test.ts src/lib/server/workspace/mailbox-query.test.ts src/lib/server/workspace/session.test.ts src/lib/server/workspace/shared.test.ts src/routes/api/webhooks/resend/server.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp wrangler d1 migrations apply flaremail-db --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp wrangler d1 migrations apply flaremail-db --remote --config wrangler.deploy.toml
